title: Laurance Rockefeller's weekend at Medway Plantation

tellings.quote: invited me and, uh, John Mack and Edgar Mitchell and, uh, Joe Lules, who's a UFO investigator from uh, El Paso, to his Medway plantation in uh, South Carolina

plain: In the 1990s, the wealthy philanthropist Laurance Rockefeller invited a small group of people interested in UFOs to his Medway Plantation, an estate in South Carolina. The writer Whitley Strieber, who says he was one of the guests, tells Michels that the others were the Harvard psychiatrist John Mack, the astronaut Edgar Mitchell, and Joe Lules, whom Strieber calls a UFO investigator from El Paso. He tells it as a sign that one of the richest families in America took the subject seriously enough to gather these people in private.
